# Factory E-locker Plug N Play Mod

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Unplug the chassis harness from the factory DLCU, then plug it into an adapter unit. [t117]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Unplug the vehicle's chassis harness from the factory DLCU (locker computer).
2. Plug this same chassis harness into the new adapter unit.
3. Plug the original chassis harness back in to complete the circuit.

_Procedure reported by [t117]._

## Parts

- Factory E-locker Adapter Harness [t117]

## Tips & gotchas

- The adapter uses factory-style connectors, so no new wiring work is required if you can handle a locking plug. [t117]
- It bypasses the 'OK am I ready' protocols that limit locker engagement to 4Lo and speeds under 4 mph. [t117]
